data.one_liner: Type‑safe Dart client for Ollama’s chat, generation, embeddings, audio and model management APIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart classes to call Ollama’s REST endpoints for chat completions, streaming responses, multimodal embeddings, speech generation, transcription, and model operations. Handles configuration, retries, and error handling without requiring Flutter.
use_when: You need direct access to a local or Ollama Cloud server from Dart or Flutter
You want streaming chat or audio responses with type‑safe models
You require model management (pull, push, delete) and cloud usage reporting
avoid_when: You need a higher‑level abstraction that includes UI widgets
You prefer a Flutter‑only package with built‑in widgets
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Ollama API, including newer speech and System One features
weaknesses: Limited to Ollama backend; not a generic LLM client
No UI components, so you must build your own UI

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another Dart client for Ollama/LLM APIs with a similar feature set
